package.description: Desktop app for managing .NET MAUI developer tools

en-US.description: Desktop app for managing .NET MAUI developer tools
en-US.longDescription: MAUI Sherpa is a desktop application for macOS, Windows, and Linux that helps manage your .NET MAUI development environment. It provides a unified interface for Android SDK management, Apple Developer tools, environment diagnostics, DevFlow app inspection, and GitHub Copilot integration.
en-US.name: Maui.Sherpa
